title: b7z9.50a: fuzz harness discovery — testcase.yaml + prj.conf for lichen/tests/fuzz so nightly twister runs them
description: Child of b7z9.50 (R-APPC-013): add testcase.yaml + prj.conf to lichen/tests/fuzz so .github/workflows/fuzz.yml zephyr-fuzz job (west twister -T ...) discovers the three harnesses. Match the harness reality: libFuzzer builds where available, FUZZ_STANDALONE fallback otherwise; keep the standalone mains working. Verify on heft: west twister (or targeted cmake build) discovers and runs the fuzz targets without regressions; document the nightly expectation.
close_reason: Landed as ci(fuzz) commit on beads-worker-4. APPROACH AMENDED from the bead's original wording (twister discovery) with justification: the three C harnesses are plain C libFuzzer/standalone binaries (lichen/tests/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt, project(lichen_fuzz C)) — NOT Zephyr apps — so 'west twister -T lichen/tests/fuzz -p native_sim' structurally discovers nothing and can never run them. The nightly zephyr-fuzz job's C step now builds standalone (cmake -B build-fuzz -S lichen/tests/fuzz -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang; cmake --build) and runs each binary with fixed iterations+seed: fuzz_frame 5000, fuzz_schnorr48 2000, fuzz_schc 20000. clang added to the apt-get install line (was gcc-only; CMakeLists requires Clang or it skips the targets). Verified empirically on heft with the exact CI commands (fuzz-schc-build dir): all three build and run clean, no crashes, ASan/UBSan active via FUZZ_STANDALONE flags. yaml.safe_load valid; GitHub Actions run: uses bash -e so build/iteration failures fail the job; crash artifacts step above still applies to rust targets. R-APPC-013 conformance: all three spec-named parsers (frame.c, schnorr48.c, schc.c) are now exercised nightly. Cleanup note (not required for correctness): the job's west init/update/zephyr-export steps are now dead weight (~CI minutes only) — left for the CI owner. Sibling b7z9.50.4 (sanitizers.conf wiring for native_sim tests, R-APPC-009) remains open.
